title: The Lantern in the Reeds
summary: On Day six, Nora finds the second light and learns it is not who they hoped.

beats.text: Day six. At first light I found a lantern in the reeds. Still warm.
A little rowboat was tied beside it. Empty.
Pip ran to it. "Jonah!" she shouted, and the birds burst from the pines.
I clamped a hand over her mouth. Far off, feet dragged through the needles.
They drifted away. Not yet, I thought. Not yet.
Inside, Pip turned the lantern over and her face fell.
"Jonah's lantern has a blue ribbon," she whispered. "This one has none."
"Nora, someone rowed that boat across in the dark. Someone who knew where you were."
beats.speaker: tess

beats.text: Fresh boot prints ran from the reeds to our porch.
Ava turned off the lamp. On the porch, a board creaked.
